title: 弥生賞の後に・次こそ絶対！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket loses to Narita Taishin and cries in frustration at her defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taishin, though reluctant to admit it, seems to have gained a new respect for Ticket's wholehearted efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket begins training once again, in order to win against her rivals at the Satsuki Sho.
